message: Field "T.required": @default("null") is the JSON value null, which the contract cannot tell apart from SQL NULL. Remove the @default or give it another JSON value; either changes the column default on Prisma 7's next migration.

Field "T.optional": @default("null") is the JSON value null, which the contract cannot tell apart from SQL NULL. Remove the @default or give it another JSON value; either changes the column default on Prisma 7's next migration.

Field "T.list": @default(["null"]) holds the JSON value null, which the contract cannot tell apart from SQL NULL. Remove the @default or give it another JSON value; either changes the column default on Prisma 7's next migration.
